title: Computers
contentHtml:
I have always liked computers, some of my first memories are of them, and they have made sense to me in ways that most things don’t, most things are fluid and move into each other or have a gradient of answers.

But computers don't, the logic they follow is the strictest I’ve interacted with, even a car engine does not follow as strict of logic, as with time the materials move around slightly and during long hours of use its ability to function will lessen as it becomes tired.

Not that computers don’t have their eccentricity, their pure logic doesn’t line up with our reasoning, just because we have done every thing that reasonably is needed for something to work, that doesn’t mean that in the logic of the computer it will.

title: Philosophy
contentHtml:
Now this may be because I’m in my 20s but I genuinely believe I have figured something out and I want to share it, I want to make a place where I can practice Philosophy and create a structured environment for others to follow the steps I took and to make there own.

I think now more than ever, the skills that only humans can do need to be cultivated, and Questing for Truth is one of them, I’d want to focus less on Philosophy based on linguistic definitions, and more on Philosophy based on personal understanding, holding all aspects of something within one’s self and then coming to a conclusion at a level lower than language.

title: Stories
contentHtml:
I want to tell stories, stories are the fundamental unit that I use to understand the world around me, but I don’t have any place to put them, right now they only live in my head, I’ve made a few attempts to pen them but I always get in my way. I'm hoping by giving them a ‘place,’ even if its only a little website that only I have access to, maybe that will help me build something bit by bit.

The stories I want to express

  • Comic
    • Space Cowboys and the Axe

      A mix of Firefly and Cowboy Bebop, the main thing I want to say with this story is no matter how deep your sin or what atrocities you’ve partaken in, trying to do good and be a better person matters.

  • World Building
    • The People and Places around the City

      Don’t really know how to explain this one but I want to talk about how people live, what they believe, how their society operates, and the rise and fall of the powers that be, in and around this fictional city.

  • Mini Painting
    • Trench Crusade minis

      I just want to paint these things as its a fun and relaxing thing to do
